title: Oct 13 Results + Oct 14 Preview: Let's Call It What It Was—A Complete Whiff
summary: Oct 13 was brutal with an 0-1 start. Let's talk about why and what's next for Oct 14.

content.value:
## Let Me Be Honest: Yesterday Was Terrible

Look, I'm not here to sugarcoat anything. October 13th was an absolute disaster. We went 0-1, which means we literally had ONE pick and managed to botch it completely. The Guardians were supposed to show up against the Rays, and instead they rolled over like a team that forgot playoff baseball was happening. Zero wins. Zero excuses. That's the reality.

## The Guardians Miss: What Went Wrong

Here's the thing that drives me crazy—we picked the Guardians at 50% confidence. That's basically a coin flip, and somehow we still ended up on the wrong side of it. When you're picking at 50%, you're essentially saying "this could go either way," and yet it still stings when it doesn't pan out.

The Rays showed up when it mattered. The Guardians didn't. That's playoff baseball for you—brutal, unforgiving, and sometimes completely unpredictable. But that's why we do this. Anyone can pick winners when it's obvious. The real test is navigating these toss-up games.

## Oct 14 Preview: Redemption Time with the Dodgers

Forget yesterday. October 14th brings us a chance to get back on track, and honestly, I like what I'm seeing. Our top pick is the **Los Angeles Dodgers** hosting the Milwaukee Brewers, and we're riding with LA at 57% confidence.

Here's why this matters: Blake Snell is on the mound for the Dodgers. Yeah, THAT Blake Snell—the guy who can completely dominate when he's locked in. Going up against Robert Gasser for the Brewers? I'll take Snell's postseason experience and raw talent every single time.

The Dodgers at home in October are a different beast. The crowd, the energy, the pressure—it all works in their favor. Milwaukee's got fight, I'll give them that, but 57% confidence feels about right here. It's not a slam dunk, but it's a solid edge.

content.title: ⭐ Oct 14 Top Pick
content.value: Los Angeles Dodgers over Milwaukee Brewers

## The Bottom Line

Let's not pretend October 13th was anything other than a miss. But here's the provocative truth nobody wants to hear: **one bad day doesn't define a season, and knee-jerk reactions are for amateurs**. We analyze, we adjust, and we move forward.

The Dodgers pick for October 14th isn't about making up for yesterday—it's about finding value where it exists. Snell on the bump at Chavez Ravine against a solid but not spectacular Brewers lineup? Yeah, I'll take that action.

We're not here to go 100%. We're here to find edges and exploit them. Tomorrow's slate gives us exactly that opportunity. Let's see if LA can deliver.
